After the TTL expires, the client should consider the result no longer valid, and if it requires this data again, it should be re-fetched with a new query. Of course, this only applies to clients that cancel the asynchronous operation when they get a result. Clients that leave the asynchronous operation running can safely assume that the data remains valid until they get another callback telling them otherwise.
